# Supplementary population impact analysis for all 15 flood scenarios.
# Generates bivariate grids (Figures S1, S2), violin plots (Figure S5),
# and full summary table (Table S3).

## Setup
```{r}
source(here::here("Code/utils/loading_utils.R"))
source(here::here("Code/utils/impact_utils.R"))
source(here::here("Code/utils/export_utils.R"))
source(here::here("Code/00_scenario_definitions.R"))

load_processed_data()
```

## 1. Population-Weighted Delta Travel Time (All 15 Scenarios)
```{r}
# Load flood scenarios and subtract baseline (Full stack).
x_delta_all_supp  <- load_flood_scenarios(type = "all") - base_tt_all
x_delta_hosp_supp <- load_flood_scenarios(type = "hosp") - base_tt_hosp

# Parish-level aggregation: Population-weighted mean per scenario.
df_impact_all_supp  <- compute_parish_impact(x_delta_all_supp, Worldpop_density, Adm_boundaries)
df_impact_hosp_supp <- compute_parish_impact(x_delta_hosp_supp, Worldpop_density, Adm_boundaries)

# Classify total parish population into three tiers
df_impact_all_supp <- df_impact_all_supp %>%
  mutate(Population_bin = factor(cut(Population_Sum, breaks = c(0, 10000, 30000, Inf), 
                                     include.lowest = TRUE, labels = c("Low", "Medium", "High")),
                                 levels = c("High", "Medium", "Low")))

df_impact_hosp_supp <- df_impact_hosp_supp %>%
  mutate(Population_bin = factor(cut(Population_Sum, breaks = c(0, 10000, 30000, Inf), 
                                     include.lowest = TRUE, labels = c("Low", "Medium", "High")),
                                 levels = c("High", "Medium", "Low")))
```

## 2. Bivariate Grids (Figures S1 and S2)
```{r}
plot_bivariate_supp <- function(df, sc_label, title_text) {
  col_name <- paste0("Average_Weighted_Delta_TT_", sc_label)
  if (!col_name %in% names(df)) {
    warning("Column not found: ", col_name, " — skipping.")
    return(ggplot() + labs(title = title_text))
  }
  
  df$Weighted_bin <- factor(
    cut(df[[col_name]],
        breaks = c(0, 30, 60, Inf), include.lowest = TRUE,
        labels = c("0-30", "30-60", "60+")),
    levels = c("0-30", "30-60", "60+")
  )
  
  df_bi <- bi_class(df, x = Weighted_bin, y = Population_bin, dim = 3)
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = df_bi, aes(fill = bi_class), color = "white", size = 0.05) +
    bi_scale_fill(pal = "DkViolet", dim = 3) +
    labs(title = title_text) +
    bi_theme() + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
}

# Safe label lookup to prevent character(0) failures
safe_label_plot <- function(sc_label) {
  lp <- scenarios_all$label_plot[scenarios_all$label == sc_label]
  if (length(lp) == 0) sc_label else lp[1]
}

# Figure S1: 15-panel grid (All Facilities)
plots_all_supp <- purrr::map(scenarios_all$label, ~plot_bivariate_supp(df_impact_all_supp, .x, safe_label_plot(.x)))
stopifnot(length(plots_all_supp) == 15)

legend_bi <- bi_legend(pal = "DkViolet", dim = 3, 
                       xlab = "Δ Travel Time (min)", 
                       ylab = "Population Sum", 
                       size = 8,
                       breaks = list(
                         bi_x = c("0-30", "30-60", "60+"),
                         bi_y = c(">30k", "10k-30k", "<10k")
                       ))

figS1_grid <- wrap_plots(plots_all_supp, ncol = 3, nrow = 5)
figS1_final <- (figS1_grid | legend_bi) + plot_layout(widths = c(4, 1))

save_manuscript_pdf(figS1_final, "FigS1_absolute_15scenarios_all_facilities_supp", subdir = "Supp", width = 20, height = 35)

# Figure S2: 15-panel grid (Hospitals)
plots_hosp_supp <- purrr::map(scenarios_all$label, ~plot_bivariate_supp(df_impact_hosp_supp, .x, safe_label_plot(.x)))
stopifnot(length(plots_hosp_supp) == 15)

figS2_grid <- wrap_plots(plots_hosp_supp, ncol = 3, nrow = 5)
figS2_final <- (figS2_grid | legend_bi) + plot_layout(widths = c(4, 1))

save_manuscript_pdf(figS2_final, "FigS2_absolute_15scenarios_hospitals_supp", subdir = "Supp", width = 20, height = 35)
```

## 3. Violin Plot (Figure S5)
```{r}
# Population-weighted sampling (100k per scenario) to manage memory.
# Sampling is used for both violin plots and summary tables; with 100k
# draws per scenario the population-weighted statistics are stable.
s_all_pixels <- sample_weighted_pixels_from_raster(x_delta_all_supp, Worldpop_density, "All Facilities", 100000)
s_hosp_pixels <- sample_weighted_pixels_from_raster(x_delta_hosp_supp, Worldpop_density, "Hospitals", 100000)

pixels_sampled <- bind_rows(s_all_pixels, s_hosp_pixels) %>%
  mutate(Intensity = factor(Intensity),
         Duration = factor(Duration, levels = paste(sort(unique(scenarios_all$duration_hr)), "hr")))

# Free intermediate raster memory
invisible(gc())

figS5_violin <- ggplot(pixels_sampled, aes(x = Intensity, y = delta_tt, fill = FacilityType)) +
  geom_violin(
    aes(group = interaction(FacilityType, Intensity)), 
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), 
    scale = "width", 
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = interaction(FacilityType, Intensity)),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    shape = 18,
    size = 2,
    color = "red",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = interaction(FacilityType, Intensity)),
    fun = median,
    geom = "point",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    shape = 4,
    size = 2,
    color = "blue",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Duration, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("All Facilities" = "lightblue", "Hospitals" = "orange"), 
    name = "Facility Type"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 180, 240, 300, 360),
    limits = c(0, 360),
    name = "Change in Travel Time (minutes)"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Precipitation Amount (mm)", 
    caption = "Violin plots show sampled pixel-level distributions.\nRed diamonds indicate mean; blue crosses indicate median."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey80"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

save_manuscript_pdf(figS5_violin, "FigS5_violin_absolute_15scenarios_supp", subdir = "Supp", height = 20)
```

## 4. Full Table S3 (Flextable)
```{r}
# Compute summary statistics from sampled pixel data (population-weighted)
summary_all_supp  <- summarise_impact_metrics(
  pixels_sampled %>% filter(FacilityType == "All Facilities"),
  c("Intensity", "Duration", "scenario"))
summary_hosp_supp <- summarise_impact_metrics(
  pixels_sampled %>% filter(FacilityType == "Hospitals"),
  c("Intensity", "Duration", "scenario"))

table_data_supp <- summary_all_supp %>%
  left_join(summary_hosp_supp, by = c("Intensity", "Duration", "scenario"), suffix = c("_All", "_Hosp")) %>%
  arrange(Duration, Intensity) %>%
  dplyr::select(Duration, Intensity, 
                Mean_All, Min_All, Q25_All, Median_All, Q75_All, Max_All,
                Mean_Hosp, Min_Hosp, Q25_Hosp, Median_Hosp, Q75_Hosp, Max_Hosp)

ft_supp <- flextable(table_data_supp) %>%
  add_header_row(values = c("", "", "All Facilities (min)", "Hospitals (min)"), colwidths = c(1, 1, 6, 6)) %>%
  set_header_labels(Duration = "Duration (hr)", Intensity = "Rainfall (mm)",
                    Mean_All = "Mean", Min_All = "Min", Q25_All = "Q25", Median_All = "Median", Q75_All = "Q75", Max_All = "Max",
                    Mean_Hosp = "Mean", Min_Hosp = "Min", Q25_Hosp = "Q25", Median_Hosp = "Median", Q75_Hosp = "Q75", Max_Hosp = "Max") %>%
  theme_vanilla() %>% autofit()

save_manuscript_table(ft_supp, "TableS3_absolute_full_supp", subdir = "Supp", "Full Scenario Summary")
```

## 5. Verification (Parity Check)
```{r}
# If Main Scenario outputs exist in the environment, verify that they 
# exactly match the corresponding subset of this Full analysis.
if (exists("pixels_sampled_main") & exists("pixels_sampled")) {
  val_full <- pixels_sampled %>% 
    filter(scenario %in% scenarios_main$label) %>%
    summarise_impact_metrics(c("scenario")) %>%
    arrange(scenario)
  
  val_main <- pixels_sampled_main %>%
    summarise_impact_metrics(c("scenario")) %>%
    arrange(scenario)
  
  if (isTRUE(all.equal(val_full$Mean, val_main$Mean))) {
    message("PARITY CHECK PASSED: Main summary statistics match Full subset exactly.")
  } else {
    warning("PARITY CHECK FAILED: Discrepancy detected between Main and Full summary stats.")
  }
}
```
